response.text: Under the PRA's model risk management expectations, the board of directors is responsible for establishing a comprehensive firm-wide MRM framework that is part of the broader risk management framework and proportionate to the firm's size, complexity, and model usage [3]. The board must also set a model risk appetite that articulates the level and types of model risk the firm is willing to accept [3]. Senior management, specifically an accountable Senior Manager Function (SMF), is responsible for implementing the framework, which includes establishing policies and procedures to operationalise the MRM framework and ensure compliance [8]. This SMF is also tasked with assigning roles and responsibilities, ensuring effective challenge and independent validation, and taking prompt remedial action to keep aggregate model risk within the board-approved risk appetite [8].
